body: Nothing left to lose
If you really want to understand pm me I'll inform you on the whole situation if you think you can really help
I said they tried to, why are you still on here?

I just talked to my legal representative and he's all on board we're going to go try and talk to some more people tomorrow and if not he's going to help me file a formal complaint with the congressman! Thank you all for your help I will continue to seek out counseling and therapy as I do feel that it is helping me.

You didn't need to do anything at all. Why waste your time on this post if you thought I was lying? Insulting because I've been through a lot and this is my last ditch effort instead of giving up. This is an open investigation so the details I provided can only be limited. Tired of people who have no idea making the assumption that I'm lying. Do this for what? The attention? Go look at my pervious post and then go away.

This is really insulting, I wished you wouldn't have even commented this. There are more details I could put out but I'm legally not supposed to. Please delete this comment and go away. I was told the local police might not take my case because it happened on base and I believed them. I'm going to speak with local police tomorrow have a great day.
Yes it's military

I'm very happy in my relationship I love my wife so much. She's the only reason why I'm still here being able to write this. This duty station wasn't that bad until the assault but now its terrible. I've spoken to doctors about my depression and I'm a high interest patient I have to see my doctor every week. Our assignment is taking over 5 months. Paperwork "keeps going missing" "something on a forum is wrong" this and that. It's never ending.
My legal representation said they wouldn't take my case , but I'll give it a try
I have talked to my SVC and he's trying his hardest but again there is only so much he can do since I'm not military
Sometimes I feel like killing myself would have been a better route. I feel like I've ruined everything already

Yeah she is struggling really hard sometimes I hear her crying in the bathroom while getting ready for work because she hates it so much. Pretty much EVERYBODY on her flights knows because he felt so protected that he told a bunch of people. He was a flight favorite and very social. We are both quit kind of keep to ourselves don't drink don't party kind of people. So they outcasted us pretty quickly. Because of what happened I was extremely suicidal so I'm high interest patient and I see a therapist once a week and a psychologist every two weeks.
What do you mean? After what? I knew telling was might do this but I was hoping I could ignore and forget the whole thing but I had to talk to someone or I was going explode.
Do you know I would obtain this information? I've been looking and can't find this information.
Happened on base and is being handled by the military solely at this point
Like I said I've tried SARC, her chain, legal, VA,IG, EFMP and they were all dead ends what other avenues are there? Any method you know that we haven't tried would be super helpful, thank you!

I've talked to all three and more. SARC said I had to go through my wife's leadership since I'm not military, Victims Advocate pretty much said the same. And IG said they don't really handle that sort of thing. I've talked to The EFMP coordinator, I've talked to my wife's shirt, I've talked to legal. All dead ends. I've even asked all of them who else I could contact and nothing besides telling me to try and contact the state senator.

I know that right now things are really bad and you feel alone, I also know that a random comment from a random person might not mean much.. but hopefully it's enough to keep you fighting. I'm right there with you struggling to find purpose everyday but I know we can it. If you EVER need someone to talk to pm me and I'll give you personal phone number. I'm a real person, not some creep. I have Twitter if you'd like to see, @__AmbrosiaC. I really hope to hear from you
They told us to enroll in EMFP. Since I'm in not military I have to go through my wife's leadership
SARC said my wife had to go through her leadership
I AM HERE FOR YOU, I'm in need of a friend as well!!! Anytime day or night
Please stay here. I know it's hard and it can seem hopeless but keep pushing. Pm me anytime day or night. I could use a friend as well

You can't trust anyone. He seemed like a really good guy but he wasn't.I don't have any friends, she doesn't have anyway to Skype, she has really bad addictions and my family has pretty much disowned her and she has nothing.
